stored_ideas.name: Demographic Reserve Rule
stored_ideas.description: Monetary base expands only when the dependency ratio crosses set bands, coupling money creation to the age structure of participants verified by census oracles.

stored_ideas.name: Carbon-Weighted Gas Fees
stored_ideas.description: Transaction gas is priced by the verified carbon intensity of the validator set's energy mix, so dirty periods become expensive and clean periods cheap.

stored_ideas.name: Habitat Bond Curve
stored_ideas.description: Conservation bonds whose redemption value grows with satellite-verified habitat area restored, paying out only on measured ecological outcomes.

stored_ideas.name: Prediction-Coupled Insurance Float
stored_ideas.description: An insurance mutual reprices coverage each epoch from live prediction-market odds on the insured event, aligning float returns with crowd-updated risk.

stored_ideas.name: Labor-Backed Escrow
stored_ideas.description: Freelance wages are escrowed in a pooled contract and released by verified work-completion attestations, letting earned-but-unpaid labor collateralize short-term credit.

stored_ideas.name: Trade-Corridor Clearing Tokens
stored_ideas.description: Bilateral trade corridors mint corridor-specific clearing credits backed by verified export volumes, netting cross-border payments without global stablecoins.

stored_ideas.name: Bandwidth Futures Market
stored_ideas.description: ISP peering agreements are replaced by an on-chain bandwidth futures market where routes are purchased ahead of congestion windows.

stored_ideas.name: AI-Compute Denominated Debt
stored_ideas.description: Loans denominated in units of verified AI training compute, so repayment tracks the falling price of intelligence rather than fiat inflation.

stored_ideas.name: Commodity-Volatility Stable Unit
stored_ideas.description: A synthetic unit whose value targets a basket of commodity price volatilities, stabilized by volatility harvesting rather than collateral pegging.

stored_ideas.name: Gene-Sequence Royalty Stream
stored_ideas.description: Synthesized gene sequences carry embedded royalty streams paid per verified commercial use, sequenced through auditable licensing oracles.

stored_ideas.name: Sybil-Resistant Airdrop Market
stored_ideas.description: Airdrop allocations are determined by a secondary market in sealed reputation bids, making Sybil farming unprofitable by construction.

stored_ideas.name: Entropy-Priced Storage
stored_ideas.description: Decentralized storage rent is priced by the entropy of stored data chunks, rewarding deduplication at the protocol level.

stored_ideas.name: Insurance-Backed Validator Slashing Pool
stored_ideas.description: Validator slashings are covered by a mutual insurance pool priced by each validator's realized fault history, turning slashing risk into a tradable premium.

stored_ideas.name: Demographic Dependency Reserve Rule
stored_ideas.description: Monetary base expands only when the dependency ratio crosses set bands, using census oracles to verify age structure of participants.

stored_ideas.name: Orthogonal idea: Toll-Lane Finality
stored_ideas.description: Finality speed becomes a purchasable lane: slow lanes are nearly free, fast lanes pay validators directly, separating consensus from fee markets.
